knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Reusable instruments are cleaned and disinfected after every client.
Disinfection does not work on debris. Clean, dry, then disinfect.
Files and buffers that cannot be verified as clean are single-use. Metal instruments are reusable.

practicalCriteria: Assessor observes the candidate clean, dry and disinfect one reusable instrument in the correct order, and time the contact period
Assessor checks the clean station before and after one simulated visit
Assessor checks that a used file is discarded and not returned to the tray
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Photograph or observation record of the clean station
Disinfectant label available for the assessor
stopWorkCriteria: A used instrument is returned to the clean tray without cleaning
A cracked or pitted instrument is used
A single-use file is used on a second client
